method: built-in image_gen; one independent targeted edit per image
scope: 修整布片与红膜的高频碎边；不修改必要硬结构；未接入引擎或改动共享清单。

items.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied EXISTING polished anime fantasy character portrait. Make a targeted costume/organic-membrane edge cleanup ONLY as described below; preserve the SAME character identity, gender/species, beautiful refined Japanese anime face where present, pose, proportions, equipment, main color palette, and premium detailed material rendering. Keep the current plain pale cool gray studio gradient background and very soft contact shadow. No new scenery, particles, dirt, text, watermark or checkerboard. Keep the entire figure and all original weapons, horns, feet, claws, tail, hair and cloth ends inside the image, with clear empty gray margins all around. If necessary reframe the same pose slightly smaller for breathing room. Do not crop. Final portrait 1024x1536, 2:3.
TARGETED CHANGE:
The lower half black-and-magenta/red flowing cape and skirt currently break into numerous long narrow jagged strips with bite-shaped holes and ragged forked edges. Replace ONLY this excessive ragged fabric structure with THREE broad substantial continuous flowing fabric panels: one broad outer panel on each side behind her legs, plus one coherent inner rear skirt panel. Preserve the black/violet outer fabric and magenta/red lining, original waist attachment, elegance and overall flowing silhouette. Each panel has one controlled broad graceful curve and a smooth clean finished hem; at most one deliberate tapering end per panel. Fill all random holes and torn notches. No shredded streamers, no strings, no tiny triangular cloth spikes, no thin fringes. Keep the face, pale lavender hair and skin, delicate expression, horn crown, chest and leg armor and the complete double-ended pink crescent polearm as they are. The design must still be a striking dark elegant anime demon general with flowing layered cloth; keep refined volume and folds.
Render the revised edges crisply with clean deliberate fine linework, coherent material shading and polished highlights. Eliminate accidental micro-scratches, isolated broken bright flecks or fraying only in the edited cloth/membrane areas. This is a deliberate shape redesign of the ragged edges, NOT blur or smoothing over pixels. Do not use a blurry outline, do not flatten all details, do not turn the illustration into a simple cartoon. Leave important armor facets, bones, horns, claws, scales, weapon cutting shapes and essential anatomy exactly recognizable. No extra accessory, cloth strip, ornament, limb or floating piece.
items.visualReview: 黑红披摆已从多条撕裂尖布整理为少量宽大连续布片，破洞及密集碎口消除，保留自然折面和红色内衬。脸部、肤色、长发、角、紫甲与双端月刃保持。全身/武器均完整，沿用原构图，顶部角尖、刃尖与侧缘留白偏窄但未裁切；背景仍为干净灰渐变，非模糊糊边。
items.acceptance: Agent 图像检查；尚未代表用户最终审美确认。
